explanation: A woman from Jericho who helped Israelite spies and later became part of their people.
People sent by Joshua to explore Jericho and gather information about the enemy.
An ancient city in Canaan that the Israelites conquered under Joshua's leadership.
The promised land that God pledged to give to the children of Israel, Abraham's descendants.
Loyalty and trust in God and his promises, shown by both Rahab and the Israelites.
A red thread that Rahab hung out of her window to identify her house and protect her family during the destruction of Jericho.
The process of taking control of an area or city, as the Israelites did with Jericho and other cities in Canaan.
Commitments that God gives to people, such as the promise of the promised land to the children of Israel.
